format: 16:9 logo animation, 1920x1080, 24 fps, about 9 s, no audio yet
status: storyboard sent, awaiting go-ahead before any generation
brief: The 7 parts of the logo break apart and form 7 steps on the navy; the b jumps up the 7 steps; the steps swirl around the b and reform the logo; the b lands next to it and the word brightday stretches out from behind the b to the final 16:9 frame. High-contrast cinematic lighting with deep shadows, consistent palette, smooth fluid motion.

brand.navy_bg: #13355A (sampled from the supplied logo; the client's 'space cadet blue')
assets: brand/b-white.png and brand/wordmark-white.png (keyed from the supplied logo)

named_palette.space_cadet: background. Logo file navy is #13355A; the standard Space Cadet swatch is #1D2951 (a little more violet). Default: the logo file value, so the final frame matches the supplied logo exactly; switchable.
named_palette.vivid_raspberry: the petals, #F00870 in the logo file (standard swatch about #FF006C)
named_palette.rose_garnet: the darker overlaps between petals, #980848 in the logo file (standard swatch about #960145)

beats: 0.0-1.0 the mark alone, key light from above, deep edge shadow
1.0-1.8 the seven petals unlock and drift outward, turning
1.8-2.6 they fly into a staircase of seven steps rising left to right
2.6-4.6 the white b drops in and hops up the steps one per beat, squash on landing
4.6-5.6 from the top step the b leaps; the steps lift and swirl around it in a tightening spiral
5.6-6.4 the spiral locks back into the mark; the b lands right beside it
6.4-7.4 brightday slides out from behind the b; the b eases left and the y nudges the mark into its corner
7.4-9.0 the finished logo exactly as supplied, slow light sweep, hold

plan.openart: image2video with an exact start frame (the mark) and an exact end frame (the final logo), the storyboard as the prompt; Kling 3.0 pro 9 s (315 credits) and Seedance 2.5 Draft 9 s (540 credits) in parallel to compare
plan.lock: the last second is the real logo, crossfaded in, so the brand frame is always exact
plan.fallback: a code-built motion-graphics version from the real assets if the generated choreography fumbles the petals, the steps or the letterforms
